residents.name: Preetish
residents.notes: dislikes jackfruit and pumpkin; cauliflower is a hard AVOID since 25 Aug (reverses an old weekly favourite); eats non-veg outside on Wed/Sat but nothing non-veg touches the home kitchen; weight management ~2,000 kcal (max 2,300), high protein, high fibre, low oil

cook.name: Jaba Das
cook.schedule: Morning shift (lunch) and evening shift (dinner); prepares overnight oats after dinner for the next morning; reminder call 9:15-9:20 AM (punctuality affects lunch packing)
cook.language: Hindi voice notes; follows YouTube links (Odia dishes like Dalma, Santula confirmed in her skill)
notes: Photograph fruit/veg/dairy/bread stock after breakfast and lunch prep.
Flags shortages proactively ('paneer khatam ho gaya').
Make a small chutney from routine pudina/dhania rather than letting herbs spoil.

person_rules.note: Tofu is not a favourite; if used it goes ONLY into veg fried rice - never mixed veg curry.

dish_keyword_rules.note: Tofu only in veg fried rice - never in curries/sabzis.
Broccoli: saute only, do NOT fry.
Never add chia seeds to overnight oats.

ingredient_grade_rules.rule: Mustard oil is the default for almost everything; refined oil only where mustard oil genuinely cannot be used (e.g. aloo paratha).
Primary protein (paneer bhurji most common at lunch); cut and marinate 30 min-4 h before cooking; add at the end, never overcook.
Soak 8-12 h the night before; chole is a standing TUESDAY dish (soak Monday evening).
Hoskula Fresh; groceries Zepto; perishables FirstClub.

breakfast_style: Self-managed except overnight oats (no chia) prepared by the cook the night before.

cooking_technique.paneer: Marinate 30 min-4 h, add towards the end
cooking_technique.staples: Roti is the primary staple at both meals; lunch roti +/- sabzi (sometimes rice); dinner roti-sabzi, sometimes dal-chawal

nutrition_direction: ~2,000 kcal/day each (max 2,300), high protein, high fibre, low oil - shapes curry richness, not just protein counts
standing_instructions: Strictly vegetarian kitchen - no eggs, no non-veg cooked at home ever.
No cauliflower in any form, in meals or in the pantry (has reappeared in stock twice - enforce at sourcing).
Methi paused till ~29 Sep (temporary) - remove 'Fenugreek' from the exclusion list after that date.
Overnight oats prepared nightly after dinner, never with chia seeds.
Portions for 2 unless told otherwise; leftovers are never discarded (residents reheat) - portion to avoid waste.
Residents pack their own lunch; cook packs only if running late.
Make a small chutney from routine pudina/dhania so herbs are not wasted.
non_negotiables: No eggs, no non-veg cooked at home - ever.
Tofu only in veg fried rice - never mixed veg curry.
notes: A household member 'requiring light, low-oil, low-spice food for health' is referenced but not mapped to a named resident - confirm.
Preferred fresh cream brand not identified.
Cauliflower reappeared in pantry photos after the ban (29 Aug, 2 Sep) - flag to sourcing.
